messages:
maya: Quick sync — need to lock PRD scope for the cache-coordinator feature before EOW. Customer asks + internal perf wins.
liam: Can you spell out the minimal acceptance criteria? I want to avoid scope creep.
maya: Minimal: (1) deterministic routing for KV-prefetch decisions, (2) configurable eviction policies by model family, (3) metric hooks for per-route hit/miss and latency. Rollout via canary on 10% traffic.
sophia: Also add: must not increase p99 gen latency by >5ms at 99th for 2k token seq for hosted tier.
noah: What about kernel implications? If coordinator pushes prefetch aggressively it could increase memory pressure + kernel eviction churn.
liam: True — spec should require backpressure signals to be honored. Proposal: coordinator sets prefetch budget per GPU; runtime can reject with 429-prefetch and fall back to on-demand.
maya: Acceptance criteria list I'm thinking to include in PRD:
- functional: routing rules applied for 95% of eligible requests in canary
- perf: average token cost reduction >= 12% for batched chat workloads
- safety: automatic disable if error rate increases by 2x
- observability: dashboard with prefetch_hit_rate, prefetch_rejects, per-model mem delta
sophia: Edge cases: short lived sessions, streaming requests (partial prefix), and pinned KV for dedicated customers. Need explicit behavior for stream+prefetch.
liam: Draft snippet for runtime API change:
```
POST /v1/runtime/prefetch
{ 'model': 'redwood-rlhf-1.0', 'seq_len': 1024, 'budget': 8 }
```
Runtime must return 202 + handle async populate, or 200 if sync.
noah: For rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks with automated rollback if p99 regresses >10%.
maya: Can someone take an owner for the RFC? I can drive product text, need eng lead to own acceptance tests.
liam: I'll own the RFC. Will add test harness for replaying traffic with and without prefetch and run A/B.
sophia: I'll add the attention-optimizations note: prefetch should avoid adding prefix tokens that change attention kernel choice for long context models.
deploy-bot: Reminder: please file RFC in docs/rfcs and tag #eng-runtime for review. :bell:
maya: Thanks — Liam please ping when draft is up. Short checklist: PRD + acceptance criteria + test vectors + rollout plan + telemetry dashboard. :thumbsup:
